beats.text: In this town, whoever holds the pirate token is captain, and everyone has to do whatever the captain shouts.
beats.visual: Town square on a sunny day. A chunky pirate ship sits in the middle of the square with its sails up. On the deck a townsperson in a captain's hat holds a glowing gold skull coin high, and the whole crowd below salutes at once.

beats.text: Five years ago, a pirate ship washed up in our town square. We don't have an ocean.
beats.visual: Stormy dusk flashback with a thunder flash. The ship rides a rolling wall of blue water boxes down main street and stops in the square. The water vanishes, leaving one tiny puddle. Cut to a road sign: 'NEAREST OCEAN: 900 MILES'.

beats.text: The token was on board. Every sunset, it jumps to someone new.
beats.visual: Dusk lighting. The gold token hops out of a townsperson's pocket by itself, bounces down main street with little pops and lands in a different person's hand. A captain's hat pops onto their head and they grin.

beats.text: Grandma Pearl got it Monday. Order: everyone do the worm.
beats.visual: Grandma Pearl (white hair, glasses, purple cardigan, captain's hat) points down from the ship's deck with a determined face. The whole crowd below lies flat on the cobbles in the crowdSurf pose, wiggling.

beats.text: Big Dez got it Tuesday. Now the bakery only sells fish.
beats.visual: Main street bakery. Big Dez (tall, beard, orange shirt, captain's hat, smug face) leans in the doorway. The window display is stacked with blocky orange and blue fish, and a customer walks out holding a fish with a stunned face.

beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Three snap zooms: the customer's stunned face, a fish sitting on a cake stand, Big Dez's smug face. Small camera shake on each.

beats.text: One rule: if you shout louder than the captain, the token jumps to you.
beats.visual: Town square stage under a 'LOUDEST WINS' banner. Two townspeople face off and shout at each other with huss faces. The token zips from one hand to the other, and a captain's hat jumps heads with it.

beats.text: And me? It never picked me. Not once. I'm the quietest kid in town.
beats.visual: Kid's bedroom at dusk. Me (black hoodie with white knight emblem, grey pants, white shoes, fade haircut, headphones) sits on the bed with a sad face. Through the window, the token bounces right past my house without stopping.

beats.text: Until Friday. The token landed on Brayden. Goon Squad!
beats.visual: Dusk town square. The token bounces into the hand of Brayden (pale skin, spiky red hair, sunglasses, black vest, chain), who breaks into a grin. His two friends in matching sunglasses cheer behind him. 'GOON SQUAD!' stamps on screen.

beats.text: Brayden glued it to his hand. Captain forever.
beats.visual: Close-up. Brayden slaps the token onto his palm with a white glue blob and holds it up, smug. The sun sets behind him, and the token tries to hop away, wobbles and stays stuck.

beats.text: Pirate hats for everyone. Clap when he walks past. Yawn, and you walk the plank.
beats.visual: Quick cuts, day. The whole town in black pirate hats. A row of townspeople clapping as Brayden struts by. A sleepy townsperson trudges down the plank off the side of the ship and drops into the fountain with a big blue cube splash.

beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Three snap zooms: the dripping townsperson climbing out of the fountain, Brayden's grin, the glued token gleaming on his palm.

beats.text: Grandma Pearl tried to out-shout him. Big Dez tried. Ah, almost... almost!
beats.visual: Town square. Grandma Pearl yells at Brayden with a huss face, and the token wiggles and settles. Big Dez yells next, and the token lifts and almost peels off, then snaps back. 'ALMOST!' stamps on screen.

beats.text: So I trained. While they were clapping for Brayden, by the way, I was shouting into my pillow.
beats.visual: Kid's bedroom, quiet night. Montage: me pressing a white pillow to my face and shouting with a huss face, the posters shaking, the orange cat on the bed watching with a squint face, a wall tally going from 'DAY 1' to 'DAY 30'.

beats.text: Saturday, I climbed the ship's mast and took the biggest breath of my life.
beats.visual: Town square, day. Me climbs into the crow's nest at the top of the ship's mast. Brayden and the whole crowd look up. Me inhales with a puffed chest and a determined face. Slow push in, sails flapping.

beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Me shouting from the crow's nest with a huss face. Each HUSS sends a shockwave ring across the square with camera shake. Pirate hats blow off, sails billow and the fountain ripples. On the sixth, the token rips off Brayden's hand and shoots into the sky.

beats.text: The token ripped off his hand and flew straight to mine. Captain me.
beats.visual: The glowing token arcs through the air and smacks into my raised hand in the crow's nest. A captain's hat pops onto my head over the headphones. The crowd below cheers.

beats.text: First order: Brayden walks the plank.
beats.visual: Brayden, with a shocked face, shuffles down the plank off the side of the ship and drops into the fountain with a big blue splash. His sunglasses float on the water.

beats.text: Top ten respect.
beats.visual: Freeze frame of me saluting from the crow's nest. The Top 10 card slides in.
beats.overlay: TOP 10 RESPECTFUL MOMENTS — #1: THE QUIET KID GOT LOUD

beats.text: Whole town chanted: Zabaru! Okki tonk! Flimba sway! Barnacloo!
beats.visual: The crowd pumps their fists and dances around the ship while I do dance2 on the deck. Each nonsense word stamps on screen in a different color with a camera punch.
beats.overlay: ZABARU! OKKI TONK! FLIMBA SWAY! BARNACLOO!

beats.text: Then the token's skull spat out a treasure map. X marked my bedroom.
beats.visual: Close on the token in my hand. The skull's jaw drops open, and a rolled parchment map pops out and unrolls. A big red X sits over a little drawing of my house. My face goes surprised.

beats.text: Under my bed was a chest with a thousand more tokens.
beats.visual: Kid's bedroom. Me peers under the bed and drags out a wooden treasure chest with gold trim. The lid flips open, and a fountain of glowing gold tokens bursts up and fills the room, throwing gold light on my shocked face.

beats.text: Now everyone in town is captain. Except Brayden.
beats.visual: Town square. Every townsperson wears a captain's hat and holds a glowing token, all pointing and shouting orders at Brayden at once. Brayden, soaking wet in a plain pirate hat, scrambles between them carrying a fish, clapping, then flopping into the worm.

beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Three snap zooms on Brayden's sweaty face while he does the worm with a fish balanced on his head.

notes: The 'everyone is captain' ending undoes the underdog win and surprises no one. Replace it with a sting: the chest under my bed creaks open and a HUSS louder than mine booms out of it, because the token's real pirate captain wants it back. Also change 'Saturday' to 'A month later' so it matches the DAY 30 tally.

Set up the treasure twist. In the 'it never picked me' beat, have the token stop and spin at my window every sunset before bouncing on: it wasn't skipping me, it was pointing at the chest. Then the X on my bedroom pays off a clue. Also fix the timeline: 'Saturday' comes the day after 'Friday', but the DAY 1 to DAY 30 training montage needs a month, so say 'Thirty days later'.

A random chest of a thousand tokens breaks the 'one token, one captain' rule, and 'everyone is captain' gets muddled. Build the twist from a rule already set up instead (e.g. at sunset the token jumps to the pigeon and the whole town has to obey it). Also fix the DAY 1 to DAY 30 pillow tally: Brayden only takes over on Friday and I climb on Saturday.
